verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a keyless or file-number entry path for the core online flow. The 'Express Annual Report' item is only a link title, with no stated no-login or UBI-number entry, and the formation and registration pages give no account-free entry. The related DOR licensing page says an account is created and reused, and the probe shows the portal serves only an app shell with no keyless content.
